verdict.rationale: Evidence shows generic dispute-management tooling (list_disputes, accept_dispute_claim), webhook delivery, and standard fee schedules, but nowhere does PayPal document who bears fraud/chargeback liability specifically for agent-initiated transactions (e.g., a liability shift policy tied to delegated tokens or UCP/ACP checkout flows). The token/nonce mechanics are described technically but not framed as risk-allocation rules for merchants.
